annotations.title: Urgent care, pharmacy and the ER, open now?

description: Where to go for care on the East End, 10 verified facilities: the hospital emergency department, urgent care, pharmacies and the emergency vet, each with `openState`, `closesAt` and `opensAt` computed from the published hours line against the East End's clock (America/New_York), and `phone`. The list holds one emergency department, in Southampton, and one 24/7 emergency vet, in Riverhead. `coverage.completeness` describes how complete the list is: it is a short verified list, not a directory, so a town absent from it is a gap in coverage, not evidence that there is no care there. `verifiedDaysAgo` is the age of the hours check and `hoursConfidence` flags a stale one. `verdictCaution` appears where the hours line carries a qualifier the guide could not resolve ("seasonal extended"). `sourceCaveat` appears because all records are filed against a single source URL. Nothing returned is medical advice. With `town`, facilities in that town sort first and nothing is filtered out. `townScope` reports how the place argument was read; `townScope.recognized: false` means the name matched no East End place, the rows array is empty, and `didYouMean` lists near matches where any exist.

need.description: `er` (hospital emergency department), `urgent-care`, `pharmacy`, `vet` (emergency vet). Omit for all four.

town.description: The asker's town or hamlet ('Montauk', 'Sag Harbor'). Facilities in that town sort first; nothing is filtered out.
